Input Group

Leading and trailing addons around a TextInput, with its own focus ring (React Native has no :focus-within). Backs prompt-input and every filter field.

  • v0.2.1
  • ui
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/input-group.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/input-group.json

Dependencies

No required npm packages — this item installs through the registry dependencies below.

https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/text.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/input.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/button.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/text.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/input.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/button.json

AI SDK peers:ai@^7.0.89

Theming

Themed via border-input, bg-background, bg-input, border-ring, ring-ring, text-foreground, text-muted-foreground.

Usage

() => ( <InputGroup> <InputGroupAddon> <Text className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">$</Text> </InputGroupAddon> <InputGroupInput placeholder="pnpm registry:build" /> <InputGroupAddon> <FolderIcon size={14} className="text-muted-foreground" /> </InputGroupAddon> </InputGroup> )

The TextClassContext seam

This component publishes its class strings through the TextClassContext provider, so a parent view can restyle its nested text.
